claims.claim: Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150/E250/E350 V8 (fitment)
claims.evidence: No brand, model tag, casting number, or VIN plate is visible or read in any photo; witness confirms read_from is empty.
Origin/import status cannot be determined from an image of a dirty engine sitting in a yard; no documentation or import sticker shown.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (sold as functional unit)
claims.evidence: No start-up, compression test, or fluid-leak-free close-up provided; only static exterior shots of a grime-covered unit.

risks.risk: Engine/transmission does not run or has internal failure
risks.proof: Video of cold start with audible idle, plus compression or scan-tool reading

risks.risk: Stated fitment (Ford Econoline V8) is incorrect or mismatched
risks.proof: Clear photo of casting number, engine tag, or transmission ID plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified engine-gearbox assembly, not model-specific

risks.proof: Close-up of oil pan, valve covers, and transmission seals after wiping down dirt

risks.risk: Missing accessories (alternator, starter, sensors, wiring harness, ECU)
risks.proof: Full-unit photo showing all accessories attached, matched against a parts checklist
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing ancillary parts

risks.risk: Transmission type/condition (manual vs automatic, wear, fluid state)
risks.proof: Photo of transmission tag/ID and dipstick fluid color/level
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown transmission condition, worst case

risks.risk: Accident, fire, or flood damage history
risks.proof: Wide shots of full housing, wiring harness, and any corrosion/burn marks, plus seller statement on reason for removal
risks.if_unproven: priced as possible hidden damage, worst case

proof_requests: Photo of engine casting number / ID tag
Photo of transmission ID plate or tag
Video of unit starting and idling with sound
Close-up photos of oil pan, valve cover, and transmission seals for leaks
Wide shot showing all included accessories (alternator, starter, sensors, harness, ECU)
Statement and photo evidence on reason for removal (accident/upgrade/failure)
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used engine-transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unidentified, unverified-condition unit; the seller's fitment and origin claims are unverifiable remotely and do not raise the price without proof.
